reviewer_scope: Independent donor/security lane; no code edits, git writes, real hardware, account or credential imports

checks.name: Stable account grant alias
checks.evidence: User subject hashes the immutable legacy initial credential ID. Authentication verifies an active same-user key; grant bytes and verifier wire format are unchanged.

checks.name: Active-key and counter recheck
checks.evidence: Verified result selects matching current active credential; stored per-key counter is reloaded, update requires active=1, and revoked grants are rechecked before operation commit.

checks.name: Enrollment session and purpose binding
checks.evidence: Separate registration/enrollment/authentication maps; enrollment requires initiating user, exact session token and authorizing credential, then rechecks active key and consumes state.

checks.name: Last-key and capacity concurrency
checks.evidence: One Inner mutex serializes checks and mutation. Capacity8 checked at start and finish; revocation counts active keys and updates target in one SQLite transaction before purging account sessions and pending auth/enrollment.

checks.name: Expiry and replay paths
checks.evidence: All session-bound endpoints call session_user/prune; auth start/finish prune directly. Ceremonies120s/sessions300s. Matching authorized finish consumes state; failed wrong-session finish cannot repurpose state.

checks.name: Migration tombstones
checks.evidence: Transactional INSERT OR IGNORE migration preserves inactive original credential rows, counters and labels; no grant or operation rewrite. File-backed Rust test checks reopen and repeated migration.

checks.name: UI account identity and mutation confirmation
checks.evidence: freshSession authenticates stored sessionName, not editable account field. inFlight gates mutations. Credential rendering uses textContent; successful revocation clears session and forces surviving-key login.

checks.name: Published SDK bridge, pin and notices
checks.evidence: Pinned browser14.0.0, lock SHA512 matches verified npm tarball. options.publicKey is passed to adapter; returned JSON goes to existing Rust verifier. Build emits reviewed package MIT notice.

checks.name: Static application network surface
checks.evidence: Compiled bundle has one application fetch(path). No library fetch/XHR/WebSocket/sendBeacon found. API paths are local same-origin constants; no CDN or new service. This does not inspect platform passkey-provider sync.

checks.name: Adversarial E2E acceptance design
checks.evidence: Tests use real navigator credentials and Rust verification; include wrong-account and wrong-session enrollment, original-key rejection despite forged allow-list, surviving-key old-grant invocation, all-session and pending-ceremony invalidation, cap at finish, and restart/migration.

nonblocking_limits: No production clock-resilience claim: existing wall-clock now() fallback/clock-jump behavior is unchanged. Ceremony/session TTL paths were inspected; no 120 s/300 s elapsed-time test run by reviewer.
8 active credentials per account is the configured bound; revoked metadata is retained as a tombstone.
The grant audience alias denotes account authority, not a physical device. Credential revocation leaves same-account grants intact; withdraw grants separately.
Attestation subjects/source were parsed and tarball integrity checked; provenance signatures/certificates were not cryptographically verified.
No hardware, biometrics, platform sync or recovery acceptance.
Canceled-ceremony cleanup and retry are source-reviewed via perform/catch/finally and SDK error propagation; current69-case browser report contains no dedicated cancellation case.
